      "stride": "ElevationOfPrivilege",
      "title": "Client-sent \"purchased\" flag is trusted, so anyone can unlock premium for free",
      "scenario": "A user intercepts or crafts the app's own request to POST /premium/unlock and sends \"purchased\": true without ever paying. The server trusts that client flag and grants premium. The same single request works for every account, so paid features are free for anyone who runs a proxy tool, and all subscription revenue for the feature can be bypassed.",
      "component": "POST /premium/unlock",
      "likelihood": 5,
      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "low", "reach": "all", "harm": "money" },

      "cwe": ["CWE-602", "CWE-807"],

        "title": "Derive entitlement only from server-verified purchase state",
        "given": "a client calls POST /premium/unlock",
        "when": "the request body contains a purchased flag or any other client-asserted entitlement value",
        "then": "the server ignores the client value and grants premium only after it has itself verified the purchase with the app store"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Spoofing",
      "title": "Receipt is accepted without server-side validation against the app store",
      "scenario": "An attacker posts a hand-made or edited receipt blob to /premium/unlock.       "component": "Receipt handling in /premium/unlock",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "low", "reach": "all", "harm": "money" },
      "evidence": [ { "quote": "the app calls POST /premium/unlock with the receipt" } ],
      "asvs": ["V1.2.2"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-345", "CWE-290"],
      "plainLanguage": "Nobody checks the receipt is genuine with Apple or Google, so a fake receipt buys premium.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Validate receipts with the store before unlocking",
        "given": "a receipt is submitted to /premium/unlock",
        "when": "the server processes it",
        "then": "it validates the receipt server-to-server with the app store and checks signature, product id, bundle id and production environment, rejecting anything that fails"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Tampering",
      "title": "One real receipt can be replayed on many accounts",
      "scenario": "A buyer makes one genuine purchase, captures the receipt, and shares or sells it. Each recipient calls POST /premium/unlock with that same receipt from their own account.       "component": "Entitlement service / account entitlement store",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "money" },
      "evidence": [ { "quote": "When a purchase succeeds the app calls POST /premium/unlock with the receipt." } ],
      "asvs": ["V1.2.2"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-294"],
      "plainLanguage": "One person pays once and shares the receipt, and everyone who sends it gets premium too.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Bind each transaction to one account and reject reuse",
        "given": "a validated receipt with a store transaction id",
        "when": "that transaction id has already been recorded against any account",
        "then": "the unlock is rejected and the duplicate-use attempt is recorded for review"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "ElevationOfPrivilege",
      "title": "Unlock may target an account chosen by the caller rather than the authenticated user",
      "scenario": "The design says the server unlocks premium 'for the account' without stating that the account is taken from an authenticated session.       "component": "POST /premium/unlock authorisation",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "integrity" },
      "evidence": [ { "quote": "unlocks premium for the account" } ],
      "asvs": ["V8.2.1"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-639", "CWE-862"],
      "plainLanguage": "The server should only change the entitlement of the person who is signed in, not whichever account the request names.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Authorise unlock against the authenticated session only",
        "given": "a call to POST /premium/unlock",
        "when": "the request contains any account or user identifier",
        "then": "the server requires an authenticated session and applies the entitlement only to that session's account, ignoring identifiers in the request"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Tampering",
      "title": "Premium stays unlocked after refund, cancellation or expiry",
      "scenario": "A user buys premium, calls POST /premium/unlock, then requests a refund or lets the subscription lapse. Repeated buy-and-refund cycles give permanent premium at no cost and the server's entitlement data no longer matches reality.",
      "component": "Account entitlement store",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "medium", "reach": "many", "harm": "money" },
      "evidence": [ { "quote": "The server trusts the client flag \"purchased\": true and unlocks premium for the account." } ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-841"],
      "plainLanguage": "Someone can buy premium, get their money back, and keep premium forever.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Revoke entitlement when the store reports refund, cancellation or expiry",
        "given": "an account with premium granted from a store purchase",
        "when": "the store reports a refund, cancellation, chargeback or expiry for that transaction",
        "then": "the server removes the premium entitlement and premium checks fail for that account"
      }
    }
  ]
}
